verdict.rationale: Belvo documents retrieving transaction history through its API, with paginated List endpoints (100 results by default, up to 1000 via `page_size`) that can be filtered by `link`. Recurrent links refresh weekly and send a webhook notification, which gives a partial sync pattern. Nothing in the pack documents how far back history goes or an explicit delta mechanism for fetching only changed transactions. Missing for 10: documented transaction history depth, explicit incremental/delta sync (e.g., cursor or changed-since filter), transaction-specific endpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
